title: Data Type Conversion Inherited
text: Convert from one data type to another using inherited data type and scaling, 2 inputs, 1 output, direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Input and Output to have equal} sets the constraint for converting fixed-point data types Real World and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Port_1
ports.summary: Reference signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: u
ports.summary: Input signal to convert scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

ports.name: y
ports.summary: Output signal scalar | vector | matrix | N-D array

params.name: Input and Output to have equal
params.values: Constraint for converting fixed-point data types Real World Value (default) | Stored Integer

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
